metadata.description: Oh My Pi plugins by sethforprivacy: multi-model panel review (quorum-review, security-quorum) and two-tier orchestration (pilotfish). One marketplace, independently versioned plugins.

plugins.name: quorum-review
plugins.description: quorum-review + security-quorum skills: independent remote reviewer seats spawned in parallel, findings deduped by consensus, provenance-checked. Seats are neutral slots; you assign models in OMP config.

plugins.name: pilotfish
plugins.description: Two-tier orchestration skill: a strong model plans, integrates and does the final review; all volume work runs on a cheaper worker tier. Port of Nanako0129/pilotfish (MIT).
